package rulefixtures

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"reflect"
)

// scenario for generic_base_repository_with_reflection_dispatch: Catch-all repositories that depend on reflection-heavy generic CRUD instead of bounded repository APIs.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.
type GenericRepo struct {
	db *sql.DB
}

func (r *GenericRepo) FindByID(ctx context.Context, model interface{}, id int) error {
	table := reflect.ValueOf(model).Elem().Type().Name()
	row := r.db.QueryRowContext(ctx, "SELECT * FROM "+table+" WHERE id = $1", id)
	v := reflect.ValueOf(model).Elem()
	fields := make([]interface{}, v.NumField())
	for i := 0; i < v.NumField(); i++ {
		fields[i] = v.Field(i).Addr().Interface()
	}
	return row.Scan(fields...)
}

func (r *GenericRepo) Save(ctx context.Context, model interface{}) error {
	v := reflect.ValueOf(model).Elem()
	t := v.Type()
	table := t.Name()
	cols := ""
	vals := ""
	args := make([]interface{}, 0, v.NumField())
	for i := 0; i < v.NumField(); i++ {
		if i > 0 {
			cols += ", "
			vals += ", "
		}
		cols += t.Field(i).Name
		vals += "?"
		args = append(args, v.Field(i).Interface())
	}
	_, err := r.db.ExecContext(ctx, "INSERT INTO "+table+" ("+cols+") VALUES ("+vals+")", args...)
	return err
}
